_about: Expansion records whose NPT runs (npt_expansion.py: iso barostat, 6x6x6 conventional cell) did not stay in the reference structure, checked 2026-09-30/10-01. bcc_end = CNA bcc atoms of 432 after 40 ps of the SAME protocol at the third grid temperature (job 6428618; controls Ba|tap 420, Na|tap_ug 432, Ta|tap_ug 432). jump_pct = lattice parameter against the 0 K a0, in per cent, at the lowest grid temperature or, where jump_at_K is given, at that temperature; a healthy record starts within a few tenths of a per cent above it and rises linearly. gate = the box-free structure gate (lammps/gate/gate.json). A record listed here has no valid expansion coefficient: its slope is the slope of whatever the crystal turned into.

_held_only_by_the_barostat.Mo|tap_ug: the expansion runs stayed bcc (432 of 432 at 437 K) because an isotropic barostat cannot shear the cell; with the box free to change shape (the structure gate) the same record leaves bcc. Its expansion coefficient is that of a bcc crystal held cubic, and is kept with this caveat.
